title: Ben Dufai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Shekalim, end of chapter 2, as appointed over the lulav in the Temple; Hyman reports that Zuckermandel’s Tosefta reads Ben Rifai.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Mechon Mamre digital Tosefta Shekalim 2 paragraph lists Ben Dufai over the lulav. Zuckermandel’s Ben Rifai remains Hyman’s report, without fresh printed collation. The supplied spelling בתופסתא is retained in Hebrew; no other officials or institutional identities are imported.
